messages:
oliver: noticed a weird artifact on the latency grid for /v2/chat/completions in eu-north. p95 dips below p50 for a few minutes around 10:12UTC. screenshot: https://redwood.internal/dash/shot-20260322.png :face_with_monocle:
meera: that's only possible if the two series are not the same computation scope/path. can you paste the queries or panel config?
oliver: panel has p50 taken from 'regional_aggregate_median' and p95 pulled from 'raw-tdigest' for the region. gist: 
```
# p50 (regional_aggregate_median)
SELECT median(lat_ms) FROM region_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v2/chat/completions' AND region='eu-north' GROUP BY time(1m)
# p95 (raw tdigest)
SELECT quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) FROM tdigest('ingest') WHERE endpoint='/v2/chat/completions' AND region='eu-north' GROUP BY time(1m)
```
dan: Ah the rollup median is an across-availability-zone median built from coarse histograms. When traffic shape changed it pushed the median above the local p95. Not a math bug — a scope + reconstruction mismatch.
meera: can we avoid mixing "across-scope medians" with regional quantiles in the same panel? It's confusing for product owners.
odr: dashbot: quick-fix suggestion: switch p50 to use the same tdigest family as p95 (region tdigest median) or label the series explicitly with scope + method.
oliver: I switched p50 to region tdigest median and redeployed the panel. patch id: dsh-9123. dashbot: deploy started by oliver at 10:28UTC :rocket:
meera: after the swap the lines respect monotonicity again. p50 <= p95 <= p99.
dan: two follow-ups: 1) add a panel linter rule that flags percentiles computed from different aggregation families (tdigest|histogram|smoothed) 2) add a small provenance pill in the legend (e.g., "p50 — region / tdigest") so on-call can read at a glance.
ui-bot: UI ticket UI-5077 created "percentile legend: show aggregation scope + method" :memo:
infra-bot: INFRA-3479 filed: migrate coarse hist rollups to retain tdigest summaries for reconstructible quantiles; estimated impact: 28 dashboards.
meera: also propose a short diagnostic overlay: when pX < pY for X<Y show a yellow banner on the panel explaining mixed-scope comparison and link to diagnostics. saves pager noise.
dan: agreed. I'll add the linter + banner first. oliver can you add a samplecount sparkline under the chart so that low-N periods are obvious?
oliver: done. deploy succeeded at 10:34UTC. leaving INFRA-3479 in backlog. closing thread unless infra asks for more details. thanks all :thumbsup:
